title: Kirby Problem 4.13
exact_target: Does every large smooth manifold homeomorphic to Euclidean four-space contain the zero trace of a knot that is not smoothly slice, and can infinitely many different trace-embedding sets be distinguished?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2889 (KP-4.13). CC BY 4.0.
